title: 第四章 江水底下，有人勾魂
novel_title: 救命！我的神煞师父怎么天天亲我
content_zh:
林大柄绘声绘色道：“这地方靠近跨江大桥，过了桥就是这座城市最繁华的地带。”

    “当初城市规划的时候，这里可是出了名的‘黄金地带’，你猜现在怎么会是现在这番场景？”

    林大柄声音越说越小，他停顿了一下，期待地等待着姜无念的反应。

    见状，姜无念十分配合地往前凑了凑，双手撑在桌上杵着脸，露出一副非常好奇的表情，“为什么？”

    对她的反应很满意，林大柄喝了口水又继续说：“这可邪门得很，地段明明很好，可怪事不断。”

    “开发商换了一波又一波，不是机器莫名损坏，就是有人员接连伤亡。”

    “再加上整个帝都的自杀事件几乎都集中在这里，久而久之就算土地价格压得再低，都没有人愿意接盘。”

    “不过我听说最近好像有个老板，接了跨江大桥附近这一大片区域的开发项目，其中也包括我们所在的这块地方，就是不知道能不能扛得住咯～”

    姜无念心里暗暗吐槽，好老套的剧情啊……都什么年代了，鬼都不会进步的吗？

    听着听着，她注意力放在了林大炳身上，看起来像个乡下人，说话却很有条理。

    等他终于说完，姜无念站起来装模作样地说了句：“这地方竟然这么玄乎？那我可得好好逛逛。”

    林大柄停下了手里的动作，不放心地盯着她，好心劝道：“哎呀，你千万不要靠近，我可不想再捞你。”

    “放心吧，我才不自杀呢，马上就要天亮了，我就在这附近逛逛，不走远。”

    姜无念忍住了没有回怼，她看起来像是那么想自杀的人么？

    看她生机勃勃的样子，林大柄反倒很佩服，才一顿饭的功夫，就像换了个人，这般自我调节能力，他自愧不如。

    起身来到屋外，姜无念嫌弃地瞥了眼自己身上的衣服，回头朝屋里喊：“大叔！我暂时没去处，在你这蹭住两天行吗？”

    林大柄正好端着盘子出来，笑着回应：“行啊，只要你别再想不开，住多久都成。”

    观他面相，姜无念一脸八卦地问道：“大叔你单身不结婚，是惦记那个白月光呢？”

    被她这没头没脑的一句问懵了，林大柄发觉她竟然说对了，愣了半天才惊讶地问道：“你怎么知道？”

    “你脸上都写着呢！”
content_en:
Lin Daying said vividly: "This place is close to the cross-river bridge. After crossing the bridge, you will find the most prosperous area of ​​the city."

    “When the city was first planned, this place was known as the ‘golden zone’. Guess why it’s like this now?”

    Lin Daying's voice became softer and softer as he spoke. He paused, waiting expectantly for Jiang Wunian's reaction.

    Seeing this, Jiang Wunian moved forward very cooperatively, resting his hands on the table and squeezing his face, showing a very curious expression, "Why?"

    Satisfied with her reaction, Lin Dabiang took a sip of water and continued: "This is very evil. The location is obviously very good, but weird things keep happening."

    "The developers changed the equipment one after another. Either the machines were damaged inexplicably, or there were casualties one after another."

    "In addition, almost all suicide incidents in the entire imperial capital are concentrated here. Over time, no matter how low the land price is, no one is willing to take over."

    "But I heard that a boss recently took over a development project in a large area near the cross-river bridge, including the area where we are located. I just don't know if he can handle it~"

    Jiang Wu Nian complained secretly in his heart, it's such an old-fashioned plot... What age has it been, can't ghosts make progress?

    As she listened, she focused on Lin Dabing, who looked like a country boy but spoke in a very orderly manner.

    When he finally finished speaking, Jiang Wunian stood up and said pretentiously: "Is this place so mysterious? Then I have to take a walk."

    Lin Dadian stopped what he was doing, stared at her worriedly, and kindly advised: "Oh, please don't come close, I don't want to fish for you again."

    "Don't worry, I won't commit suicide. It's going to be dawn soon. I'll just stroll around here and not go far."

    Jiang Wunian resisted the urge to reply. Does she look like someone who wants to commit suicide?

    Seeing her lively look, Lin Dabiang admired her very much. After just one meal, she looked like a different person. He was ashamed of her ability to regulate herself.

    After getting up and going outside, Jiang Wunian glanced at his clothes with disgust, turned around and shouted into the house: "Uncle! I have nowhere to go for the time being, can I stay with you for two days?"

    Lin Daying came out with a plate and responded with a smile: "Okay, as long as you stop thinking about it, you can stay here for as long as you want."

    Looking at his face, Jiang Wunian asked with a gossipy face: "Uncle, if you are single and not married, are you thinking about Bai Yueguang?"

    Stunned by her meaningless question, Lin Dabiang realized that she was right. After being stunned for a long time, he asked in surprise: "How do you know?"

    "It's written all over your face!"
title_en: Chapter 4 There is someone seducing people under the river
